name: Butanamide, 4-amino- (9CI)
summary: Gabamide, or GABAmide, also known as γ-aminobutyramide (GABAD), is a GABA receptor agonist and GABA analogue, or more specifically the amide of the inhibitory neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA).002). Unlike progabide, but similarly to GABA, gabamide is unable to cross the blood–brain barrier and hence is peripherally selective.
